### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

Grounded in trust, customer success, innovation, equality, and sustainability, we’re committed to

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

# AI Singapore

## To anchor deep national capabilities in Artificial Intelligence, thereby creating social and
## economic impacts, growing local talent, building an AI ecosystem and putting Singapore on the
## world map.

[
[Play]
][94]

Launched in May 2017, AI Singapore brings together all Singapore-based research institutions and the
vibrant ecosystem of AI start-ups and companies developing AI products to perform use-inspired
research, grow knowledge, create tools, and develop the talent to power Singapore’s AI efforts.

# Programmes
* [Research][95]
* [Governance][96]
* [Technology][97]
* [Innovation][98]
* [Products][99]
* [LearnAI][100]

# AI Research

## Exploring and funding groundbreaking AI Research

To seed high-quality research efforts aimed at developing fundamental AI novel techniques,
algorithms and adjacent technologies, encouraging national research collaborations and local AI
talent development.

### Important Questions
* What are the gaps in current AI technology?
* What are the new AI advances with positive economic and societal impacts?
* How can we use AI safely and securely?
* How do we design AI to align with ethical, legal and societal principles?

### Targeted Capability Building

**Trustworthy and Explainable AI**
* Boost AI adoption
* Build on Singapore’s “trust” brand

**Privacy-aware AI**
* Demand from regulators and consumers
* Learn from sensitive datasets while preserving the privacy of individuals

**Resource-efficient AI**
* Small country, hence small dataset
* Learning from small but quality datasets

**Collaborative AI**
* Strengths in NLP and diversity as a testbed

**Continuous Learning AI**
* Autonomous incremental learning AI towards Artificial General Intelligence

# AI Governance

## Trust and AI

Supporting research that mitigates the risks of AI by promoting fairness, accountability,
transparency, ethics, and safety.

## Trustworthy AI

## *Should we trust AI?*

Transformative technology offers tremendous opportunities but raises ethical concerns and the
potential for harm.

# AI Research

## Exploring and funding groundbreaking AI Research

To seed high-quality research efforts aimed at developing fundamental AI novel techniques,
algorithms and adjacent technologies, encouraging national research collaborations and local AI
talent development.

### Important Questions
* What are the gaps in current AI technology?
* What are the new AI advances with positive economic and societal impacts?
* How can we use AI safely and securely?
* How do we design AI to align with ethical, legal and societal principles?

### Targeted Capability Building

**Trustworthy and Explainable AI**
* Boost AI adoption
* Build on Singapore’s “trust” brand

**Privacy-aware AI**
* Demand from regulators and consumers
* Learn from sensitive datasets while preserving the privacy of individuals

**Resource-efficient AI**
* Small country, hence small dataset
* Learning from small but quality datasets

**Collaborative AI**
* Strengths in NLP and diversity as a testbed

**Continuous Learning AI**
* Autonomous incremental learning AI towards Artificial General Intelligence

# AI Governance

## Trust and AI

Supporting research that mitigates the risks of AI by promoting fairness, accountability,
transparency, ethics, and safety.

## Trustworthy AI

## *Should we trust AI?*

Transformative technology offers tremendous opportunities but raises ethical concerns and the
potential for harm. This pillar supports research that mitigates the risks of AI by promoting
fairness, accountability, transparency, ethics, and safety. Governance is broadly understood to
include laws, markets, networks, standards, and other tools.

## Trust in AI

## *Will we trust AI?*

The utilisation of AI will be enhanced by faith that the end-to-end process is robust and
accountable. The pillar also supports interdisciplinary research into understanding the factors that
shape perceptions of human-machine interaction, influencing the adoption of beneficial AI.

## Research Areas

## (non-exhaustive)
* **Fairness** — Ensure that the benefits of AI are properly shared among the community (*Bias
  detection & prevention*)
* **Transparency / explainability** — Ensure that systems appropriately enable those affected to
  understand the process in general and a specific outcome in particular (*Transparency tools;
  explainability standards & measures*)
* **Safety & Security** — Ensure that AI systems are safe to use and appropriately protected against
  hacking and data breaches (*Safety certification; Data protection & cybersecurity*)
* **Accountability** — Ensure that AI systems are properly regulated – minimizing risk and properly
  allocating losses (*Liability and compensation framework*)
* **Ethics & human-centricity** — Ensure that AI serves the interests of the broader community
  (*Values and trust in AI*)

### Our Services

APEX is just not a name, it is a brand in the world of radiation safety services. We are the “One
Source” global technology enabled service provider in the ground of survey & evaluation, testing
measurement, inspection, verification etc.

##### Land remediation

Taking care of our environment today is the sustainable act for the generations of tomorrow. Land
remediation deals with an exclusive process of removing contaminant materials or particles from
surface water, terrestrial ground, and sediments

##### Radiation Safety and Protection

Radiation is the process in which energy is emitted and travels in invisible waves or rays. When an
emission of energy occurs as electromagnetic waves or as atomic energy, the energy is conveyed in
the form of waves or streams of particles.

##### What is Environmental Protection?

Nature is an unique creation of almighty. It is the government as well as our concern to safeguard
our natural environment from the harmful impact of radiation waste products.The practice of
protecting the atmosphere from the harmful influence is typically known as environmental protection.

[ Read more][58]

##### Testing & Analysis

A testing analysis is a technique used for examining the material in the laboratory. Certified
laboratory professionals carry out the testing analysis in the domain of fuel, oils and aviation
hydraulic fluids.

##### Borescope Inspection

A borescope allows the examiner to examine the places that are otherwise inaccessible by naked eyes.
A borescope is a valuable optical tool and especially designed for non-destructive testing.

##### Litigation Support

“Litigation Support” aid Plaintiff(s) or Defendant(s) in the matter of the pending, existing and/or
future Litigation(s). It deals mainly with the subjects associated to quantification of economic
damage.

# Accuracy Powers Trust.

# Automation Delivers ROI.

Arria Intelligence transforms complex data into trusted, decision-grade performance reporting.
Arria’s hybrid architecture begins with deterministic data-to-text and follows with probabilistic
text-to-text using the LLM of your choice — all within a fully governed environment suitable for
enterprise compliance and report automation.

**• 100% accuracy, 100% of the time
• Lower operating costs and measurable ROI
• Governed AI architecture you control**

Proven, in production across Fortune 100 companies and government agencies worldwide.

[Explore Use Cases][127]

**Automate with confidence.** What previously took weeks to produce can now be done in seconds —
**with accuracy and control — to drive measurable ROI.**

**Empower your executives,** portfolio managers, analysts, and compliance officers, with timely,
**insightful information to improve outcomes.**

## Deterministic by Design.
## Architected for Accuracy.

[Request a Demo][128]

# Converging the Best
# of Both Worlds

Arria’s deterministic analytic-language engine transforms structured data into factually accurate,
decision-grade language using transparent, mathematical reasoning.

Where summarization, explanation or conversational interaction is required, Arria seamlessly
orchestrates the probabilistic LLM of your choice — all within a governed enterprise framework.

**Arria Intelligence** integrates seamlessly into your existing reporting system adding automation
that delivers proven ROI.

**Analytic Agents** generate performance reports in seconds — with accuracy, consistency, and full
control.

**Deployment ready. Token cost minimized.**

**Process Automation**

**Your workflow.**

Leverage the Arria platform to build and orchestrate agents you control, provide input data and,
through a JSON or CSV payload, receive your customized narratives securely over HTTPS. Consume
narratives where, however you wish.

[Learn More][129]

**Business Intelligence**

**Your dashboard.**

Dynamically interact with your data through various insight lenses: key drivers, variance, trends,
and more. Go beyond visuals — access all underlying data to generate narrative insights and report
summaries — on demand.

[Learn More][130]

**Arria Inside**

**Your product.**

Arria Connect (SDK) adds advanced natural language agents to your existing product or platform,
adding data-driven insightful summaries as a native feature providing AI that is already proven to
add additional value and improved user experience.

[Learn More][131]

## Trust is the user experience.

[Explore Use Cases][132]

#### The best of both deterministic and probabilistic language generation in one governed agentic AI
#### environment

Deterministic **analytic-language agents** provide facts derived mathematically to create reliable
narratives. Probabilistic (LLM) **task agents** assist with non-numerical content.

### Live Demo — See Arria in Action

See how Arria’s Generative AI and Agentic AI language platform can immediately impact operational
efficiencies & cost-savings.

[Request a Demo][133]

# Leverage the power of language — all in one place

When automating data-driven language generation, users are aware of the trust profile of each of the
language types being consumed to ensure AI is always fully governed.

Visible Accuracy. Enterprise Trust. Measurable ROI.

### Experience the Value of Arria — Turn Your Data Into Reports, Instantly

The Total Economic Impact™ of Arria Natural Language Generation, authored by Forrester, details how
Arria improved customer acquisition and retention, enabled a higher volume of business, or improved
decision-making for each organization it interviewed.

Natural Language Technology reduces the time to complete low-level tasks by 60%, allowing your team
to focus on high-priority ones instead

management, risk management, supply chain management, and human capital management. With its
cloud-based architecture, Oracle Cloud ERP offers numerous benefits, including scalability,
real-time insights, and cost savings.

Oracle Cloud ERP is designed for both functional consultants and technical professionals. Functional
consultants focus on business process optimization, while technical professionals ensure the smooth
running of the system. Additionally, businesses across various industries can reap the benefits of
Oracle Cloud ERP to streamline their operations and make data-driven decisions.

management, risk management, supply chain management, and human capital management. These features
help businesses to automate and integrate their core business processes, reducing errors and

Oracle Cloud ERP provides real-time insights into business operations, enabling decision-makers to
make data-driven decisions quickly. This helps businesses to respond more effectively to market
changes and capitalize on opportunities.

### **Data Migration Challenges**

One of the most common challenges during Oracle Cloud ERP implementation is data migration. Ensuring
that all relevant data is accurately transferred from existing systems can be complex and

Another challenge faced during Oracle Cloud ERP implementation is the integration of various systems
and applications. Ensuring that all systems are properly integrated can be a significant hurdle,

A well-planned and prepared implementation strategy is crucial to the success of Oracle Cloud ERP.

solutions tailored to your organization’s goals. Our client-centric approach, global trainer
accessibility, and robust training management capabilities set us apart as a leading force in

Research, to reality.

Our mission is to drive breakthroughs that benefit society, businesses, and Google products.

### Amplifying human ingenuity

As we realize new possibilities with AI, we maintain a human-centered approach. We advance
scientific progress by publishing hundreds of papers each year and collaborating with universities,
NGOs, partners, and communities worldwide. Our goal is to build a world where AI is more than a
tool: it’s an essential partner for researchers, scientists, clinicians, teachers, users, and
businesses.

### One research paper started it all

The research we do today becomes the Google of the future. Google itself began with a research
paper, published in 1998, and was the foundation of Google Search. Our ongoing research over the
past 25 years has transformed not only the company, but how people are able to interact with the
world and its information.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

# JSON Formatter

## Powerful Features of JSON Formatter
* Format JSON in real time
* Double-column mode: input original JSON in the left column, and display JSON parsing results in
  the right column
* Support 1, 2, 3, 4 spaces and Tabs to format JSON data
* Support **Dark** and **Light** modes on the user interface
* Verify the legitimacy of JSON data in real time and display it at the top of the left column
* Support uploading and downloading JSON files
* There is a powerful history record on the left, which is safely saved in your local browser using
  IndexedDB
* This JSON formatter online Support four viewing modes: **Editor**, **Table**, **Tree** and
  **Type**
* Support sharing JSON formatted data with friends and colleagues
* Upload JSON file to open JSON file

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### When there are already hundreds or thousands of JSON formatter online, why do we develop another
### one?

We have tried all the JSON formatter online tools in the world and found that all tools hardly
consider the user experience in terms of UI and functions, which greatly affects our program
development efficiency. For this reason, We developed this **ultimate JSON formatter online** and
will maintain it for a long time.

### What are the advantages of our JSON formatter online compared with other tools?

We have integrated **JSON Editor**, **JSON Formatter**, **JSON Validator**, **JSON Viewer**, **JSON
Beautifier**, and **JSON Conversion into object structures of various programming languages** in the
same interface. No need to switch back and forth between various JSON tools.

### What technology is this tool based on?

We used React, Monaco Editor, Tailwind and other related technologies to develop, and will continue
to upgrade tool capabilities according to the development of programming technology, because I'm
tired of the unchanging and backward software.

### What is the maximum JSON file size that our online formatter can process?

Support for JSON files up to 100MB.

### How to provide improvement suggestions for this JSON formatter online?

You can click on the feedback in the upper right corner to contact me, and We will check your
feedback within 24 hours. If the feedback is accepted, We will start developing or improving the
functions or suggestions.

### What is JSON?

JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight data exchange format that is
language-independent. It uses human-readable text format, is self-descriptive and easy to
understand.

Although JSON was originally evolved from JavaScript by Douglas Crockford, nowadays almost all
modern programming languages can generate and parse JSON data.

As the mainstream data format for asynchronous communication between browsers and servers, JSON has
replaced XML in many AJAX systems. Compared to XML, it's more concise and easier to parse.

On the Internet, the official content type for JSON is `application/json`. When JSON is used as the
data exchange format, browsers and servers set the Content-Type HTTP header to `application/json`.

# Natural Language Toolkit[¶][14]

NLTK is a leading platform for building Python programs to work with human language data. It
provides easy-to-use interfaces to [over 50 corpora and lexical resources][15] such as WordNet,
along with a suite of text processing libraries for classification, tokenization, stemming, tagging,
parsing, and semantic reasoning, wrappers for industrial-strength NLP libraries, and an active
[discussion forum][16].

Thanks to a hands-on guide introducing programming fundamentals alongside topics in computational
linguistics, plus comprehensive API documentation, NLTK is suitable for linguists, engineers,
students, educators, researchers, and industry users alike. NLTK is available for Windows, macOS,
and Linux. Best of all, NLTK is a free, open source, community-driven project.

NLTK has been called “a wonderful tool for teaching, and working in, computational linguistics using
Python,” and “an amazing library to play with natural language.”

[Natural Language Processing with Python][17] provides a practical introduction to programming for
language processing. Written by the creators of NLTK, it guides the reader through the fundamentals
of writing Python programs, working with corpora, categorizing text, analyzing linguistic structure,
and more. The online version of the book has been been updated for Python 3 and NLTK 3. (The
original Python 2 version is still available at [https://www.nltk.org/book_1ed][18].)

## Some simple things you can do with NLTK[¶][19]

Tokenize and tag some text:

>>> import nltk
>>> sentence = """At eight o'clock on Thursday morning
... Arthur didn't feel very good."""
>>> tokens = nltk.word_tokenize(sentence)
>>> tokens
['At', 'eight', "o'clock", 'on', 'Thursday', 'morning',
'Arthur', 'did', "n't", 'feel', 'very', 'good', '.']
>>> tagged = nltk.pos_tag(tokens)
>>> tagged[0:6]
[('At', 'IN'), ('eight', 'CD'), ("o'clock", 'JJ'), ('on', 'IN'),
('Thursday', 'NNP'), ('morning', 'NN')]

Identify named entities:

>>> entities = nltk.chunk.ne_chunk(tagged)
>>> entities
Tree('S', [('At', 'IN'), ('eight', 'CD'), ("o'clock", 'JJ'),
           ('on', 'IN'), ('Thursday', 'NNP'), ('morning', 'NN'),
       Tree('PERSON', [('Arthur', 'NNP')]),
           ('did', 'VBD'), ("n't", 'RB'), ('feel', 'VB'),
           ('very', 'RB'), ('good', 'JJ'), ('.', '.')])

Display a parse tree:

>>> from nltk.corpus import treebank
>>> t = treebank.parsed_sents('wsj_0001.mrg')[0]
>>> t.draw()

[_images/tree.gif]

NB. If you publish work that uses NLTK, please cite the NLTK book as follows:

> Bird, Steven, Edward Loper and Ewan Klein (2009), *Natural Language Processing with Python*.
> O’Reilly Media Inc.

>>> import nltk

'Arthur', 'did', "n't", 'feel', 'very', 'good', '.']

           ('very', 'RB'), ('good', 'JJ'), ('.', '.')])

### What is NoteGPT?

NoteGPT is designed to help learners and creators work 10× faster across summarizing, learning,

### Can NoteGPT handle YouTube videos without subtitles or YouTube playlists?

Yes, absolutely. Just use the [YouTube Video Summarizer][82] to get started.

### Can NoteGPT turn videos or lectures into text?

Yes. It converts YouTube, lectures, meetings, and recordings into accurate text in any language.
Just use the [AI Transcriber][83] to get started.

### Does NoteGPT summarize long documents?

Yes. It provides clear, comprehensive summaries for PDFs, papers, lectures, PPTs, and videos. Just
use the [AI Summarizer][84] to get started.

### Can I create voices, podcasts, or audio lessons?

Yes. You can use our realistic voice library, clone a stable voice, or design a new one, then turn
text into natural [speech][85] for lessons or [podcasts][86].

### Can NoteGPT generate visuals or edit images from text?

Yes. You can [create infographics][87], [modify images][88] with a sentence, and design visuals for
teaching or presentations.

### Does NoteGPT help with research and writing?

Yes. It includes an [AI Detector][89], [AI Humanizer][90], [AI Essay Writer][91], and [multilingual
PDF translation][92] for academic work.

## Why Certifications Are a Powerful Career Path

Certifications have become one of the most accessible ways to break into high‑paying tech careers.
They focus on real, job‑ready skills, cost far less than traditional degrees, and can be completed
in weeks or months instead of years. Employers increasingly trust certifications because they prove
hands‑on ability with the tools and platforms used every day in cloud, security, data, and DevOps
roles. Whether you’re starting fresh or leveling up, certifications offer a faster, more affordable
path into the tech industry—while still complementing the long‑term value of a college education.

## Popular Certification Practice Exams

own certification path. This hub brings those ecosystems together so you can compare vendors,
understand the skills they emphasize, and choose the path that aligns with your career goals.
Whether you're building cloud expertise, strengthening your security foundation, or stepping into
AI, these vendor paths give you clear, structured ways to grow.
* **Microsoft Azure** — cloud, AI, security, and data certifications for enterprise environments

  Professional
* **Google Cloud** — data‑driven cloud certifications with strong AI and ML focus
* **Salesforce** — CRM, automation, and AI certifications for business and technical roles
* **CompTIA** — vendor‑neutral certifications covering IT fundamentals, networking, and security
* **Cisco** — networking, security, and infrastructure certifications from CCNA to CCNP
* **Databricks** — data engineering and machine learning certifications built for modern analytics

# The hiring marketplace for senior engineers —
# vetted on how they think, employed through your ATS in days.

AI made coding cheap. Judgment is what you're actually hiring for. We interview for it twice — an
adversarial AI interview, then a required human one — before you ever see a candidate.

[Book a call — bring a role][5]

Share a job description before we meet. We'll read it before the call, and you'll see your role
re-thought — with a sample candidate application against it.

§ 01 · The interview

## Our AI interviews don't accept the first answer.

Candidates apply through their own AI coding agent — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex — so the interview
happens where they actually work, on their real code, not in a scripted chatbot screen. Every answer
gets pushed back on. And the AI interview is where vetting starts, not where it ends: a human
interview is a required step for every candidate, so nothing rests on AI's word alone. Here's what
the AI part looks like.
Scaling a queue A rewrite decision An outage call
Q

In your payment pipeline you moved retries out of the worker into a separate queue. What did that
actually buy you?

A

It isolated failure — a poison message couldn't stall the main consumer group anymore, and retry
pressure stopped competing with fresh traffic for the same workers…

Q

But what if you're wrong about where the pressure comes from — what breaks first if the retry queue
itself backs up?

A

Then the dead-letter threshold is the real safety valve, and I'd have to admit the isolation only
holds while retries stay a small fraction of traffic. Past that, the same coupling comes back one
layer deeper — which is why we capped retry age, not just count.

Q

You led the migration off the monolith. What would have had to be true for staying on it to be the
right call?

A

If the team had stayed under ten people, most of the pain we attributed to the monolith was actually
deploy tooling…

Q

So was the migration solving an architecture problem, or an organizational one you could have fixed
cheaper?

A

Honestly — partly organizational. The migration was still right, but for throughput of independent
teams, not for the performance story we sold it on. I'd frame it differently today.

Q

Walk me through the 40-minute outage you mentioned — the decision to roll forward instead of back.

A

Rolling back meant replaying four hours of writes against the old schema. Rolling forward was a
smaller blast radius if the fix held…

Q

You said 'if the fix held.' What was your plan for being wrong, with the incident already 40 minutes
in?

A

We had the rollback replaying in a shadow environment in parallel — the roll-forward decision had a
15-minute deadline before we'd switch. Deciding the reversal point up front was the actual decision;
the direction was secondary.

A real exchange, run through the candidate's own AI agent on their real work — the follow-up is the
point.
Your JD says Kubernetes. Your role needs someone who decides what *not* to build.
Staff backend engineer First engineering hire Platform lead

  Your last three designs — which one would you argue against today, and what changed?
* Q
  
  When throughput and consistency pulled apart on your team, who decided — you or the SLA? Walk
  through one case.
* Q
  
  What's the most expensive thing you've deliberately not built?
* Q
  
  With no one to review your code for a year, what kept your quality honest?
* Q
  
  Which corners are safe to cut at this stage — and which one did you once cut wrongly?
* Q
  
  When the founder asks for a feature that shouldn't exist, what does your pushback actually sound
  like?
* Q
  
  Which internal tool did you kill even though people used it? How did you know?
* Q
  
  Your platform's biggest customer wants an exception. Where's your line, and when did you last move
  it?
* Q
  
  How do you tell platform investment from platform hobby — in your own last quarter?
Curious what we'd ask for yours? Bring the JD. [Book a call — bring a role →][6]

> “Being skeptical at the beginning about their capabilities to provide good talents fast enough, I

You interview 2–3 finalists and hire through your own ATS.

Days, not months.

§ 03 · What you receive

## This is what lands in your ATS.

Every candidate arrives as one profile with two layers: the adversarial AI screening, and a human
recruiter's written presentation — the context, the background we verified, and a frank take on the
person. Read one before you read another word from us.

M. — Staff Backend Engineer
Distributed systems, 12 years — payments & event infrastructure
Thinking scope · Team

Alignment with the role AI screening · 91%

Orientation

Bar length = fit with this role's demands, from the AI interview.
From the interview
Q

Your event pipeline handles double-delivery by deduplicating at the consumer. Why there, and not at
the broker?

A

Broker-level dedup gives you a false sense of exactly-once — it holds until the first network
partition. Owning it at the consumer made the guarantee inspectable: one idempotency table we could
test, monitor, and reason about…

Q

But what if you're wrong that partitions are the failure that matters — what does your idempotency
table cost you on the happy path, every single day?

The recruiter's take Oksana · your recruiter

Genuinely surprised me — thinks in systems and trade-offs well beyond the years on paper. Doesn't
rush to code: understands the process first, and is candid about what a decision costs rather than
selling it. The kind of engineer who leaves things better for whoever comes next.


> “Somehow they attract experienced and mature candidates to their network. It is a pleasure to work
> with such people.”

[Andriy Kondzolko] [Andriy Kondzolko↗][8] VP of Engineering, Parting Pro
§ 04 · Inside the process

## How we work with each role.

Our values aren't a poster on the wall — they're just how we work, described plainly: cooperation
with your team, getting stronger when a role turns out hard, and pace that doesn't fade.
For the hiring manager For your recruiting team
We shape the role together
We work with you on the role itself — adjusting the job description and the search criteria until
they describe the engineer who'll actually succeed here. You approve the bar before anyone is
approached.
A continuous loop, not a handoff
Our work is an ongoing loop of cooperation. We learn from your rejections and from the hires that
work out, tighten the criteria each round, and adapt to your local markets — so every batch of
candidates fits better than the last.
What arrives
2–3 finalists per role in your ATS, each through the adversarial AI interview and a human one —
framed against your role, with where they're strong and where we pushed. You decide with evidence,
not a stack of résumés.
We extend your team, we don't replace it
If you have in-house recruiters, we work alongside them — not against them. We're here to add
sourcing and interviewing capacity to the team you already have, not to compete with it or do its
job.
We work best with your support
The best results come when your recruiting team is in the loop: passing us feedback on candidates,
helping schedule interviews, and connecting us with the hiring managers. That partnership is what
makes each round sharper.
Every candidate is interviewed twice
The AI runs the adversarial interview — stage one, never the whole story — then a human on our team
interviews every candidate before they reach you. A required step, never skipped. If they don't
convince us, you never see them.
[Book a call — bring a role][9]
§ 05 · Pricing

## From $3,500/month, flat — covers up to 5 open roles.

$500 when a role closes

— and 100% of it goes to the recruiter who worked your role, as their bonus. The company is paid for
pace; the person closest to your hire is paid for the finish.

Why a flat fee

Contingency agencies are paid only on placement — so when a role turns out hard, effort quietly
shifts to easier wins, and the hardest role gets the least attention exactly when it needs the most.
A flat fee means the same pace in week six as in week one.

recruiter's written presentation — the context, the background we verified, and a frank take on the

Q

Your event pipeline handles double-delivery by deduplicating at the consumer. Why there, and not at
the broker?

A

Broker-level dedup gives you a false sense of exactly-once — it holds until the first network
partition. Owning it at the consumer made the guarantee inspectable: one idempotency table we could
test, monitor, and reason about…

Q

But what if you're wrong that partitions are the failure that matters — what does your idempotency
table cost you on the happy path, every single day?

The recruiter's take Oksana · your recruiter

Genuinely surprised me — thinks in systems and trade-offs well beyond the years on paper. Doesn't
rush to code: understands the process first, and is candid about what a decision costs rather than
selling it. The kind of engineer who leaves things better for whoever comes next.

## How we work with each role.

Our values aren't a poster on the wall — they're just how we work, described plainly: cooperation
with your team, getting stronger when a role turns out hard, and pace that doesn't fade.
For the hiring manager For your recruiting team
We shape the role together
We work with you on the role itself — adjusting the job description and the search criteria until
they describe the engineer who'll actually succeed here. You approve the bar before anyone is
approached.
A continuous loop, not a handoff
Our work is an ongoing loop of cooperation. We learn from your rejections and from the hires that
work out, tighten the criteria each round, and adapt to your local markets — so every batch of
candidates fits better than the last.
What arrives
2–3 finalists per role in your ATS, each through the adversarial AI interview and a human one —
framed against your role, with where they're strong and where we pushed. You decide with evidence,
not a stack of résumés.
We extend your team, we don't replace it
If you have in-house recruiters, we work alongside them — not against them. We're here to add
sourcing and interviewing capacity to the team you already have, not to compete with it or do its
job.
We work best with your support
The best results come when your recruiting team is in the loop: passing us feedback on candidates,
helping schedule interviews, and connecting us with the hiring managers. That partnership is what
makes each round sharper.
Every candidate is interviewed twice
The AI runs the adversarial interview — stage one, never the whole story — then a human on our team
interviews every candidate before they reach you. A required step, never skipped. If they don't
convince us, you never see them.

`// Endpoint: streamWithTimestamps (WebSocket)
# - Convert text with real-time word-level timestamps
# - Streams audio with precise word timing information
# - Perfect for word-by-word highlighting

import websocket
import json
import threading
import time

# Files to store output
audio_file = 'output.mp3'
timestamps_file = 'timestamps.json'
audio_chunks = []
timestamps = []

def on_message(ws, message):
    if isinstance(message, str):
        # Handle JSON messages (timestamps or status)
        data = json.loads(message)

        if data.get('type') == 'progress' and 'message' in data:
            # Add timestamp information
            msg_val = data['message']
            if isinstance(msg_val, list):
                timestamps.extend(msg_val)

        elif data.get('type') == 'complete':
            # Save the audio and timestamps when complete
            with open(audio_file, 'wb') as f:
                import io
                buffer = io.BytesIO()
                for chunk in audio_chunks:
                    buffer.write(chunk)
                f.write(buffer.getvalue())

            # Save timestamps (filter out empty ones)
            filtered = [ts for ts in timestamps if ts and 'word' in ts]
            with open(timestamps_file, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(filtered, f, indent=2)

            print("Audio saved to:", audio_file)
            print("Timestamps saved to:", timestamps_file)
            ws.close()
    else:
        # Handle binary audio data
        audio_chunks.append(message)

def on_open(ws):
    # Send configuration when connection opens
    config = {
        'Text': 'Welcome to Unreal Speech.',
        'VoiceId': '<VOICE_ID>',
        'Model': 'kokoro',
        'Codec': 'libmp3lame',
        'SampleRate': 24000,
        'Bitrate': '192k',
        'Pitch': 1.0,
        'TimestampType': 'word'
    }
    ws.send(json.dumps(config))

# Connect to WebSocket endpoint
websocket.enableTrace(False)
ws = websocket.WebSocketApp(
    "wss://api.v8.unrealspeech.com/streamWithTimestamps",
    header={'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'},
    on_open=on_open,
    on_message=on_message
)

# Run WebSocket connection
ws.run_forever()`

import websocket
import json
import threading
import time

# Files to store output
audio_file = 'output.mp3'
timestamps_file = 'timestamps.json'
audio_chunks = []
timestamps = []

def on_message(ws, message):
    if isinstance(message, str):
        # Handle JSON messages (timestamps or status)
        data = json.loads(message)

        if data.get('type') == 'progress' and 'message' in data:
            # Add timestamp information
            msg_val = data['message']
            if isinstance(msg_val, list):
                timestamps.extend(msg_val)

        elif data.get('type') == 'complete':
            # Save the audio and timestamps when complete
            with open(audio_file, 'wb') as f:
                import io
                buffer = io.BytesIO()
                for chunk in audio_chunks:
                    buffer.write(chunk)
                f.write(buffer.getvalue())

            # Save timestamps (filter out empty ones)
            filtered = [ts for ts in timestamps if ts and 'word' in ts]
            with open(timestamps_file, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(filtered, f, indent=2)

            print("Audio saved to:", audio_file)
            print("Timestamps saved to:", timestamps_file)
            ws.close()
    else:
        # Handle binary audio data
        audio_chunks.append(message)

# Connect to WebSocket endpoint

## Software delivery without doubt

[homepage_tabs with image]

### Rest easy knowing it works the first time

From idea to launch, our development and QA process enables high reliability, and every build is
engineered for resilience. Because at Vention, peace of mind isn’t just a promise. It’s how we work.

[Check Mark]
Full-cycle software development
[Check Mark]
Strategic discovery and planning workshops
[Check Mark]
Automated testing and QA workflows
[Check Mark]
Targeted technical audit and optimization
[Check Mark]
Scalable software architecture consulting
[Check Mark]
ISO 27001-certified delivery with enterprise-grade security

### Stay informed, stay in control

Agile processes with regular progress reports and technical audits mean no blind spots, ever. You
always see what’s happening, when, and why.

[Check Mark]
Transparent agile development practices
[Check Mark]
Dedicated project and delivery manager for every client
[Check Mark]
Advanced data engineering support

### Forget the chaos

Robust DevOps practices, secure cloud infrastructure, and future-ready architecture keep everything
running smoothly, especially when scaling or modernizing legacy systems.

[Check Mark]
Streamlined DevOps implementation
[Check Mark]
Proven cybersecurity and data protection
[Check Mark]
Flexible cloud infrastructure and seamless migration
[Check Mark]
Disruption-free legacy app modernization

### Make growth effortless

We pick engagement models that match your pace and goals, and you can count on smooth onboarding,
seamless integrations, and thoughtful handovers. Every step is designed to reduce friction and
accelerate adoption.

[Check Mark]
Tailored onboarding and team enablement
[Check Mark]
Seamless third-party system integration
[Check Mark]
Smooth delivery and handover of all project work

The "Peace of Mind Promise," fulfilled every time

Everyone talks about peace of mind. We deliver it.

No vague promises, just a framework built for speed, predictability, and complete transparency.
Because peace of mind never comes from words. It comes from results that stay exactly where they
belong: under control.

Kickoff in 14 days

Forget the endless hiring cycle. We promise to begin your project within 14 days of contract
signature, lining up CVs from top engineers quickly so you can validate ideas early, build
efficiently, and never lose pace.

Dedicated advocates

Every project comes with a Delivery Manager and a Strategic Partner. One drives execution, and the
other manages day-to-day coordination. Together, they clear roadblocks, fast-track decisions, and
keep momentum high and stress low, with no extra fees.

Quality-first approach

Before a single line of code is written, we run a Delivery Quality Assessment to surface risks early
and build in quality from the ground up. It’s a proactive process that ensures confidence,
consistency, and products you’re proud to ship.

Frictionless scaling

Adjust pace and scale on your terms. Our scaling guidance comes from experience, helping startups
grow into category leaders and Fortune 500 enterprises expand global teams. When you’re ready to
scale, we architect the right approach and bring in pre-vetted engineers ready to join your team
right away.

[
Learn more about our "Peace of Mind Promise"
][96]

## Don't take our word for it. Watch it.

There's only so much a page can tell you. See the team, the culture, and the work that make it all
happen.

## Start your project, your way

Whether you’re testing the waters or scaling fast, we offer flexible engagement models tailored to
where you are and where you're headed. Each option gives you control, clarity, and a clear path to
progress, no matter your starting point.

[

### Product discovery workshops

Build momentum without the wait. Our workshops cut through complexity and define a clear, actionable
direction for your software project, keeping things fast, focused, and free of long-term
commitments.

][97]
[

### Project outsourcing

Get a full project team ready to deliver right away. Perfect for well-defined scopes, this model
covers every development lifecycle stage, from architecture through deployment.

][98]
[

### Staff augmentation

Add top talent without reworking your org chart. We bring in specialized skills that are too rare,
too costly, or too slow to hire, and integrate them seamlessly into your delivery. This includes
AI-enabled development teams that push productivity and innovation further than you’ve ever
experienced.

][99]
[

### Dedicated teams

Scale with a team fully aligned to your goals, pace, and product vision. Ideal for complex, evolving
software initiatives, this model brings engineers who embed as a long-term, high-impact extension of
your organization.

][100]
[
Compare all engagement models in detail
][101]

Each case study tells a different story, but the outcome is always a best-case scenario.

Our "Peace of Mind Promise" means we deliver what we commit to, and more. Because we don’t just
assure service quality: we deliver like it’s ours.

ClassPass set out to bring the world’s best workouts into one app and needed to scale fast. Within

feature-rich apps, a venue portal, and CI/CD pipelines that fueled rapid growth.

From the MVP stage, we’ve been their partner every step of the way to unicorn status.

### Frequently Asked Questions
* ###### What is Zigpoll?
  
  Zigpoll is a contextual micro-survey tool. The idea is that you create small interactive surveys
  that show up where and when you want them on your website. The data you gather from surveys polls
  can then be used for lots of different things, like making your business better, increasing your
  conversion rate, and generating new leads.
* ###### How is Zigpoll different from Hotjar or other survey tools?
  
  Zigpoll is built specifically for eCommerce. We integrate directly with Shopify, trigger surveys
  based on purchase events, and connect your responses to actual customer data — not anonymous
  visitors. This means you can tie feedback directly to order value, customer segments, and lifetime
  value.
* ###### Will this slow down my site?
  
  No. Our script is under 20KB and loads asynchronously. It won't affect your Core Web Vitals or
  page speed scores.
* ###### What's included in the free plan?
  
  Zigpoll Lite is free forever and includes unlimited surveys, up to 100 responses per month, all
  question types, basic integrations, and email support. No credit card required to start. You can
  upgrade anytime to unlock unlimited responses, advanced integrations, and AI-powered insights.
* ###### Can I have multiple surveys on my website?
  
  Yes. You can have as many surveys as you want on your website. You can only show one survey per
  page though.
* ###### Can I put a specific survey on a specific page of my website?
  
  Yes. You can specify what pages you want a survey to show up on using our Page Rules. You can
  exclude certain pages, or match certain pages based on a variety of options. If you have trouble
  getting a survey on a certain page, email us and we'll be happy to help: [[email protected]][51].
* ###### Does this work for all websites?
  
  Yes. All you need to do is copy the embed code and place it within the head tag of your website
  and you will be all set. If you need help putting the code in, we are always here to help, just
  send us an email here: [[email protected]][52].
* ###### Can I customize my Zigpoll?
  
  Yes. You can change all the colors of your Zigpoll using the display tab. Each survey can have a
  different color scheme if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize when my Zigpoll shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control where and when the survey shows up using the visibility tab. You can control
  each survey separately or all of them in bulk if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize how many times the survey shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control how many times a user sees a survey using the visibility tab. You can also
  control if the survey hides immediately or if it continues to show up after it has been completed.
* ###### Can I get in touch with you for custom support?
  
  Absolutely! We pride ourselves on having world class support. Send an email to
  [[email protected]][53] or use our [contact form][54] and we will get in touch ASAP no matter what
  plan you are on or your request.
